workflow.step_1_extract: Export carton artboard to clean SVG using pdftocairo -svg or vectorcraft extract.
workflow.step_2_dom_cluster: VectorCraft parses SVG DOM nodes. Group all child paths under target bounding envelopes into a single atomic compound path.
workflow.step_3_swap: Replace the identified compound path node with the clean SVG paths of BlueStone_Primary Logo_CMYK.ai.
workflow.step_4_monochrome_force: Apply fill='none' to all white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) and map stroke/fill to Cyan 100% (Pantone 286 C) for carton panels.
workflow.step_5_render: Compile modified SVG back to production PDF and render 150 DPI preview JPG.
